Hi Ellen — thanks for sending these over. Quick review from procurement and finance: COI looks complete for limits, but we need an endorsement with the following explicit language on an ACORD 101 addendum or insurer letter before we can create the PO:

- "Redwood Inference, its officers, directors, employees and agents" listed as Additional Insured for General Liability on a primary and non-contributory basis
- Waiver of subrogation in favor of Redwood Inference for General Liability and Auto
- Policy effective dates that cover the full contract term (contract start date 2026-11-20 through 2027-11-19)

Also, our finance team requires the vendor name on the W-9 to exactly match the payee name on the PO. In the W-9 you sent the DBA line is populated; can you confirm the legal entity name for PO issuance?

If you can provide a signed endorsement and confirm the legal entity name, I’ll route to AP and generate the PO. If there’s any insurer delay, we can accept a binder plus written confirmation from the carrier underwriter (carrier code/UW reference) while the formal endorsement is issued.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
